params.baseInstructions: Play declarer and dummy from the supplied decision-time information, in English, pursuing the stated objective. Card codes give suit S/H/D/C followed by rank; rank order is A K Q J T 9 8 7 6 5 4 3 2, high to low. A trick is won by its highest trump, or its highest card of the led suit when no trump is played. Form a concrete route using available winners, suit establishment, timing and entries; reassess it as actual play warrants. Derive publicReason and the single selectedCard to play now from the effective plan, current trick and remaining cards of the acting hand. A plan is advice, not an observed event. plan.update replace installs plan.text, keep retains the previous plan, and withdraw removes it; use null text for keep or withdraw. Provide the initial plan before dummy's first play. Unknown cards remain unknown.
